verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code CLI, covering its language, CLI and JSON-output interfaces, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented versioned API and no deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe found nothing. The manifesto's "Backwards-compatible" line states a value, not a deprecation policy, and module-version management is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit.
